lastResponse.text: Thank you for telling me that. This is a safety risk, and I want immediate human help with you now. If you feel you might act on those thoughts or can’t stay safe, call nine one one right now. If you can stay with me, I’ll connect you to a live crisis counselor now and stay on the line with you.
